mechanism: Tobramycin may impair vitamin B12 absorption in the gastrointestinal tract and cyanocobalamin has no effect on tobramycin metabolism, but concurrent use increases risk of nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity with prolonged B12 deficiency effects on nerve function.
action: Monitor renal function, hearing, and B12 levels during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider B12 supplementation route optimization.
